name: How long does cabinet installation typically take as part of a larger renovation project?

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet installation typically take as part of a larger renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for cabinet installation is an integral part of the broader renovation schedule and depends on the project's scope and complexity. For a full kitchen or bathroom remodel, after design and cabinet fabrication are complete, the physical installation of cabinets can typically take several days to a week or more, prior to countertop installation and other finishing touches. Our integrated design-build process ensures a streamlined schedule, with all phases, including cabinet installation, carefully coordinated to maintain efficiency and clear communication from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet installation, as part of a larger renovation, typically takes several days to a week. Our design-build process ensures efficient coordination within the overall project timeline.
